preconditions.expression: isinstance(A, list) and isinstance(B, list) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in A) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in B)
preconditions.description: A and B are lists of integers.
The lengths of A and B match the provided integers N and M.
The sizes N and M are within the specified constraints.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if any((sum(A) - a + b) == (sum(B) - b + a) for a in A for b in B) else return_value == -1
postconditions.description: Returns 1 if there exists a pair (a, b) with a in A and b in B such that swapping them equalizes the sums of the two arrays; otherwise returns -1.
